exclusion_detail: The abstract names families, not one best compound (L-threo 13a-e and 13g-k as pan inhibitors, TFB-TBOA analogues 3b-e, hybrids 8 and 9), and the conclusion gives no single featured compound or follow-up experiment.

lead.label: none
lead.why: Abstract lists compound series (13a-e, 13g-k; 3b-e; 8 and 9) with no single best or lead compound; no in vivo or other follow-up on one compound.

notes: Chemoenzymatic route (MAL-L384A enzyme step) for most compounds; the DL-threo building block 16 comes from a previously reported Sharpless aminohydroxylation. Did not assess other compounds for a looser rule.
